Description & Requirements
 Who we are looking for
 Are you passionate about cyber security challenges associated with threats and vulnerabilities, in the IT industry? Are you passionate to continuously learn and develop yourself and others? Are you interested in a role that offers the opportunity to support and work with large international clients and conduct penetration testing in highly sensitive and complex environments? If yes, then Deloitte’s Cyber team could be the place for you! We are looking for an experienced penetration tester, who is open to learn and develop new methodologies and techniques, mentor others and build teams. You will be part of a large team of penetration testers who will support you in your learning and knowledge building.
 About you:
5+ years of experience in Penetration Testing, Offensive Security, Red Teaming, or a similar role
Solid coding skills in scripting languages (e.g., Python)
Solid knowledge web/mobile/binary applications security, and common attack vectors
Solid knowledge in internal/external infrastructure testing
Hands-on experience with Cloud & Kubernetes penetration testing
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and modern adversary techniques
Strong communication skills—you can explain technical findings to both engineers and business stakeholders.
Ability to lead and mentor a team of penetration testers on complex projects.
EU work permit
 Nice to have
Vulnerability research or exploit development
Purple Team/Red Team engagements
AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenCode, PI etc.)
AI/LLM security testing
German language
 Your future role
Lead end-to-end penetration testing engagements across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, kubernets, binary applications and internal/external infrastructure.
Simulate real-world attacks to identify security risks before they become threats.
Mentor junior penetration testers and help grow a high-performing offensive security team.
Develop custom tools, scripts, and automation to make penetration testing smarter and more scalable.
Design and improve penetration testing processes , workflows, and internal platforms.
Deliver clear, actionable reports that help technical and business stakeholders understand and mitigate risk.
tay ahead of the latest vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and emerging security trends.
 What we offer
 Opportunities for professional growth, including mentoring, conferences, training, and certification.
 A supportive, collaborative, and motivational work environment.
 Involvement in the development of innovative applications.
 A wide range of benefits and the stability of working with a reputable company.
 Be part of a large penetration testing team with like-minded deeply technical people
 Selection process
 1 step - Pre-screen with recruiter (15 min);
2 step - Technical interview (1 hour) - online;
3 step - Professional interview with Team Leaders (1 hour) - online;
4 step - Welcome on Board!
 About Deloitte
 Deloitte is a variety of people, experience, industries and services we deliver in 150 countries of the world. It is an intellectual challenge, a good starting point for your career, and an excellent opportunity for continuous development and gaining valuable life experiences. What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process and sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.
